headline: HII Names Chris Helton as Vice President of Infrastructure and Sustainability at Newport News Shipbuilding
summary: NEWPORT NEWS, Va., Aug. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- HII (NYSE: HII) announced today that Chris Helton has been appointed vice president of infrastructure and sustainability at its Newport News Shipbuilding division. In his new role, Helton will oversee infrastructure modernization improvements at the shipyard, as well as facilities, environmental health and safety, and security at NNS.
